summary: {clerk} keeps a small gift from a member who noticed how tired the reader looked after a run of votes.
realLife: Swanson recalled a young Lyndon Johnson giving him a silver lighter engraved with Johnson's initials after successive roll calls. Swanson later passed it to a naval colleague.
gates: The applicable ethics rules permit the gift.
inGame: needs: the historical gift rules and a personal recollection.

turns.what: The initials recall who came over to the desk.
turns.writesBack: The object figures in a later interview.

turns.pulledBy: The clerk passes it to a friend.
turns.what: The friend keeps the physical reminder.
turns.writesBack: The clerk has only the story left to tell.
